about.title: About Hamro Ward
about.intro: Hamro Ward answers one question: who represents your ward, and where that information came from.
about.whatBody: Local government information for Nepal — wards, elected representatives and the sources behind them — in one place, in plain language. This is not an official website of the Election Commission or of any government body.
about.notBody: We do not tell you who to vote for, we do not recommend a party, and we do not rank representatives as good or bad. Nobody's information moves up the page by paying us. Our job is to show the evidence; the judgement is yours.
about.operatorPending: The operating organisation is not named publicly yet
about.operatorPendingHelp: Its registration is not finished. Publishing a name without a registration number anyone can check would be an unverifiable claim, and not making those is the whole principle of this site. Both will appear here once they are ready.
about.betaBody: The information is incomplete, and where it is incomplete we say so. A seat with no name against it means we have not established who holds it — not that the seat is empty.
sources.title: How sources work here
sources.intro: Every fact on this site carries a record of where it came from. Anything without a source is not presented as a fact.
sources.orderBody: The Election Commission first, then the Government of Nepal, then the municipality and its ward offices, then public government documents and reputable journalism. Something circulating on social media is treated as a claim to check, not as evidence.
sources.stateHeading: The three states a seat can be in
sources.stateHeldHelp: There is a name, and that name has been checked against an official source.
sources.stateVacantHelp: The seat is empty, and a source confirms it is empty. A seat nobody stood for at the last election counts as vacant.
sources.stateNotVerifiedHelp: We have no source we can stand behind. That does not mean the seat is empty; it means we do not know. Those are different answers, and we show them differently.
sources.conflictBody: If two sources say different things we do not quietly pick one and hide the other. We keep both, show the disagreement, and say which source carries more authority.
sources.correctionsBody: Send it to us. Corrections that arrive with a source get dealt with first.
sources.correctionsPending: There is no corrections address yet. It will be published here once the operating organisation is settled.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draftNotice: This is not the full privacy notice
privacy.draftNoticeHelp: The full notice will be published before citizen accounts and issue reporting open, after legal review by the operating organisation. What follows is only what is true of this beta today.
privacy.noAccounts: There are no accounts. You do not give us a name, an email address or a phone number, and we do not ask for one.
privacy.noTracking: There are no advertising or tracking scripts, and this site sets no cookies in your browser.
privacy.serverLogs: Like any website, the server keeps an ordinary record of requests. How long those are kept will be settled together with the operating organisation.
privacy.nextBody: Citizen accounts and local issue reporting will mean you give us more. What is collected, how long it is kept and who can see it will all be written here — before any of it starts.
beta.banner: This is a beta. Information may be incomplete.
person.scopeNote: This page shows only the seats held in {place} today. Seats held in other municipalities, and terms that have ended, are not shown here.
evidence.title: Where this came from
evidence.intro: This information rests on the documents below. Which document, who published it, and when — all of it is here.
evidence.none: No source recorded for this yet
evidence.noneHelp: That does not mean the information is wrong; it means we have not yet found a document we can stand behind. Which is why it is not shown as confirmed.
evidence.conflictHelp: Different documents say different things. We have not picked one and dropped the other — both are below, the more authoritative one first.
evidence.howBody: The Election Commission first, then government bodies, then the municipality and its ward offices, then documents and journalism. Something on social media is a claim to check, not evidence.
evidence.field.party_id: Which party they were elected for

search.title: Find your municipality or ward
search.help: Type the name of a municipality. If you know your ward number, put it after the name — for example “Koshara 4”.
search.emptyHelp: Try part of the name instead. Or your municipality may not be open on Hamro Ward yet — we add them one at a time.
account.signIn.title: Sign in
account.signIn.intro: Sign in to report a problem in your ward and follow what happens to it.
account.signIn.failed: Those details do not match an account.
account.register.title: Create an account
account.register.intro: We ask for an email so reports stay accountable. Your name is never shown on public pages.
account.register.displayNameHelp: Moderators see this. Readers of a published report never do.
account.register.failed: The account could not be created. Please check the form and try again.
account.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easier to remember than a jumble.
account.wait: Too many attempts. Wait about {minutes} minute(s) and try again.
account.offline: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
account.verify.title: Check your inbox
account.verify.sent: We sent a link to the address you gave. Open it to confirm the address, then sign in.
account.verify.why: Reporting needs a confirmed address. Reading Hamro Ward never does.
account.verify.resent: If that address needs confirming, a link is on its way.
account.verify.resendLabel: The address you signed up with
account.verify.done: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
account.verify.expired: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.
account.verify.pending: Your email is not confirmed yet.
account.forgot.title: Reset your password
account.forgot.intro: Give us your address and we will send a link for setting a new password.
account.forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. It works for 60 minutes.
account.reset.title: Choose a new password
account.reset.done: Your password is saved. You are signed in.
account.reset.noToken: This page needs the link from your email. Ask for a new link if you no longer have it.
account.reset.badToken: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
